# agentgrid

> Spawn grids of coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor) in one command. agentgrid is an agent-native,
> self-improving agent employee, Lattice, whose job is dispatch: it splits work across agents in tmux panes, hands
> out missions and tracks each pane to done. Use it from any coding agent through its MCP server, its skills, its
> Claude Code plugin or its command line.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what it does, every tool and how to call it, what not to do
- [README.md](README.md): install, quick start, how it works
- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): Lattice, the agent employee: mission, personality, boundaries

## Skills

- [skills/agentgrid/SKILL.md](skills/agentgrid/SKILL.md): spawn a grid of coding agents
- [skills/agentgrid-orchestrate/SKILL.md](skills/agentgrid-orchestrate/SKILL.md): hand out and track work across a running grid
- [skills/agentgrid-sessions/SKILL.md](skills/agentgrid-sessions/SKILL.md): save, restore and replay grids and presets

## MCP tools

- [src/mcp-server.ts](src/mcp-server.ts): the `agentgrid-mcp` server, 15 tools: grid_create, grid_status, grid_broadcast, grid_kill, grid_equalize, grid_dashboard, pane_send, pane_read, pane_rename, pane_add, pane_inject, preset_list, preset_load, session_save, session_restore
- [.mcp.json](.mcp.json): the server's one-line config for any MCP client

## Plugin and sub-agents

- [.claude-plugin/plugin.json](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the Claude Code plugin (skills, sub-agents, MCP server, hooks)
- [hooks/hooks.json](hooks/hooks.json): hooks that color each pane by its agent's status
- [.claude/agents/grid-operator.md](.claude/agents/grid-operator.md): sub-agent that runs a grid for a plan
- [.claude/agents/pane-doctor.md](.claude/agents/pane-doctor.md): sub-agent that diagnoses a stuck pane
- [gemini-extension.json](gemini-extension.json): the Gemini CLI extension
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](.well-known/agent-card.json): the A2A agent card

## How it improves itself

- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract and its honest level
- [eval/run.sh](eval/run.sh): the evals (smoke, surfaces, golden tasks with pass^3)
- [scripts/improve.mjs](scripts/improve.mjs): one turn of the nightly improvement loop
- [memory/MEMORY.md](memory/MEMORY.md): the memory index
- [memory/LEARNINGS.md](memory/LEARNINGS.md): every correction, kept as a rule
